notes: The Art House is run by the design studio Acrylicize at 30-36 Pritchards Road (its own site). Nights and events seen on the studio's pages: Peaks of Imperfection, exhibition open 24 to 30 April 2026 (drop-in, free), with a portrait drawing workshop on Sat 25 April, a stitch and chat drop-in on Sun 26 April, and a supper club and film screening on Thu 30 April (ticketed). The studio's perspectives list does not say where JOY, a two-day gathering, took place, so it is not attributed here. The triage row uses the id art-house; the map lead used art-house-acrylicize.
